bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's own booking site, by phone or by email (contact@michel-sarran.com). Lunch is served Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 12pm to 1.45pm, dinner Monday to Friday from 8pm to 9.45pm; closed at weekends, from 1 to 30 August and from 19 to 27 December 2026.
groups: Three private rooms for 8, 12 and 20 guests; the whole restaurant can be booked privately.
